description: A push-up performed with a slow tempo to maximize time under tension and build solid chest strength.
setup: Start in a high plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, glutes squeezed, and abs braced.
steps: Lower your chest toward the floor slowly over three full seconds.
Tap chest lightly or hover one inch above the ground without losing tension.
Press back up to top lockout over a controlled two-second count.
cues: Maintain a strict three-second descent cadence on every rep
Keep whole body rigid like a moving board from ears to heels

mistakes.mistake: Speeding up halfway down to escape the burn
mistakes.fix: Count three slow Mississippi seconds from top to bottom

mistakes.mistake: Leading with the chin or dropping head early
mistakes.fix: Keep neck packed and neutral so chest touches down first

rep_standard: Must take a full 3 seconds to lower and 2 seconds to press up, reaching chest within 1 inch of floor and full elbow lockout.
